MAP REWORK · MOCKUP B
The Sound
One big highland island lies across the wind and
splits the sea in two. Two ports on the windward
side, two on the lee side. Go round either cape or
take Needle Sound, a narrow reef strait through it.
SAMPLE TRADE LEGS (SLOOP, STEADY WIND)
Timber run · Calda → Stonehaven
489 units · ≈ 44 s · downwind through the Sound
Stone haul · Stonehaven → Westholm
458 units · ≈ 40 s · close reach round West Cape
Fish · Saltmere → Calda
384 units · ≈ 31 s · close-hauled past Tern Cay
WHAT CHANGES
• A single strong landmark the player learns fast
• Every north–south delivery is a route choice
• Ports are the biggest islands after Greatholm
• Reefs guard both capes and the Sound
• Outer islands become locked future ports
• Open water kept north-east and south-west
KEY
Trading port (pier, town, what it makes)
Locked island: future port, unlocked later
Reef: rocks and coral, solid to the hull
Shallows glow · darker blue = deep channel
Static mockup, not game geometry. Times use the real sloop polar.
